snippet.title: Meikyu — Daily Dungeon Deduction Puzzle | Official iOS Trailer
snippet.description:
Six tries to crack the lineup. Win a floor, go one deeper.

Every day, a gate opens on a new floor of the dungeon. Five residents wait behind it. You have six tries to work out who they are — and where they stand.

Every sortie leaves a report:
• Green ring — right piece, right slot
• Gold ring — right piece, wrong slot
• Gray cross — not on this floor

Crack the lineup, uncover the residents’ hidden house rules, and keep every discovery in your Dungeon Codex.

Download Meikyu for iPhone and iPad:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id6797902664

Official website:
https://meikyu.app/

Works offline. No account. No ads.

#Meikyu #PuzzleGame #iOSGames
